workflow.audit: every step writes to supabase.admin_audit via the service role; the JSONL audit log (system/data/audit/) remains as a local fallback until Phase B is verified
workflow.description: Hourly Gold Council signal cycle. DESIGN ONLY — maps each step to the existing Python module. No auto-trading: the workflow produces documented recommendations only, never executes trades. Paper mode until a live phase is approved. Signal cap 3/day (ceiling, not quota). Review mode first; auto-publish only after ~30 reviewed signals.

failure_handling.data_stale: abort as no_signal and flag staleness; do not trade on old bars
failure_handling.no_signal: normal outcome — log it, publish nothing, do not invent a signal
failure_handling.telegram_api_error: retry the send once; the pending row stays queued for /pending — nothing is lost

hard_rules: NO auto-trading ever — recommendations only, never execute trades, no broker integration
No Pocket Option anywhere in this workflow
Paper is labelled paper in every card, chart and journal row
Max 3 signals per UTC day — a day with no opportunity publishes 0
No invented signals to fill the cap
Review mode: every signal waits in the pending queue for Mohamed's approve/reject
Losers are shown in the journal; no result is hidden or edited
workflow.name: gold-council-signal-cycle

inputs: free DXY proxy from 6 Dukascopy pairs
steps.name: Load market data
steps.on_error: abort cycle as no_signal; log staleness if the latest bar is older than 2h (known 2026-11-08 stale-data incident)
outputs: df (H1 candles, last closed bar only — no lookahead)

gates.then: return blocked_by_news — no signal, record the reason
return blocked_by_shock — all agents silenced, no signal

steps.module: system/pipeline.py::run_pipeline — L0; agents/r1_pair.py, agents/r0_regime.py, agents/n0_news.py, agents/r2_timeframe.py
steps.name: L0 routers (sequential)

L1_context: C2 sentiment (LLM/3a2l — abstain if unavailable, never fabricate)
C5 COT (best-effort, silenced on fetch failure)
L3_execution_proxies: X3 OFI — all CME/Dukascopy proxies, honestly labelled; spot FX has no central order book

steps.contract: each agent: analyze(df/ctx) -> {agent, signal +1/-1/0, confidence 0-100, detail (Arabic)}
steps.db_write: supabase.agent_votes — one row per agent per signal (vote, confidence, detail, weight, degraded flag)
steps.name: L1+L2+L3 agents (parallel)
outputs: outs[] — one vote dict per responding agent

steps.db_write: supabase.agent_votes.weight — the weight applied at arbitration time

gates.then: return no_signal — votes split, no consensus

inputs: weights (from data/learned_weights.json today; from supabase.learned_weights_history after Phase B)
steps.name: M1 arbiter

steps.db_write: supabase.corrections — attacks count, veto flag, attack text

gates.then: veto — proposal killed, record as no_signal

steps.name: M3 devil's advocate
M2 risk — card numbers
outputs: card {symbol, direction, entry, stop (1.5x ATR), tp1 (1.5R), tp2 (Fibonacci extension), confidence, R:R, validity 8h, risk 1% ($100)}

gates.then: return no_signal — record the failed evaluation, do not silently drop it

steps.db_write: supabase.signals — one row (day_utc, daily_seq 1-3, review_status='pending'); supabase.agent_links — no write here (E2 maintains links offline)

gates.then: do NOT log, do NOT publish — cap reached

steps.name: Journal the signal (with daily cap)
outputs: signal_id, or -1 when the 3/day cap is reached

steps.name: Render chart image
steps.note: Chart file path is stored on the signal row (chart_path); the image itself stays on disk until a media store is chosen in Phase C
outputs: chart PNG (H1 candles + entry/SL/TP lines + PAPER watermark)

modes.auto: publish immediately — enabled ONLY after ~30 reviewed signals (mode toggle in bot_config.json)
modes.review: queue only — wait for Mohamed's approve/reject via /pending or /admin

steps.name: Review queue (review mode)
outputs: pending row; review DM (card + chart) to each admin via api.send_photo/send_message

steps.db_write: supabase.signals.review_status='published', published_at, channel_message_id; supabase.subscriber_signals — one row per active subscriber
steps.name: Publish approved signal
outputs: per-subscriber journal rows for active subscribers

steps.db_write: supabase.settlements — outcome, exit_price, pnl_r; supabase.signals.status + pnl_r; supabase.progress — recompute wins/losses/win_rate/streak per affected subscriber
steps.name: Settle closed signals
Learn (offline, not in the hourly path)
steps.note: Runs as a separate scheduled job (weekly), never inside the hourly cycle. A weight change requires run_kind, sample_n and t_stat recorded. Current honest state: latest walk-forward t-stat +0.75 — no proven edge yet.
